rich_narrative.summary: ICNA Chicago Illinois Organization serves the local community through social services, community outreach, and religious education. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="3">$1,386,389 in total revenue</cite> to run programs such as GainPeace, ICNA Relief, and Young Muslims [3][5]. The charity operates as a direct service provider and maintains <cite id="2">verified zakat eligibility across multiple asnaf categories</cite> including the poor (fuqara) and needy (masakin) [2]. Third-party evaluation shows a mix of positive governance markers and financial efficiency constraints. ICNA Chicago holds <cite id="1">a 92 out of 100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite> and spends <cite id="1">only $0.08 to raise every $1</cite> [1]. However, in FY2024, its <cite id="3">program expense ratio stood at 70.5%</cite>, which falls below the standard 75% benchmark [3]. Additionally, the organization holds <cite id="1">35.4 months of working capital in reserve</cite>, indicating significant accumulated assets that could be deployed more actively into current charitable operations [1].
